name: lightspeed
description: Manage your Lightspeed Retail (X-Series) store via the myHub-hosted Lightspeed MCP gateway — products, variants, inventory, sales, customers, registers, promotions, price books, gift cards, loyalty, suppliers, stock orders, and service orders. Browser OAuth through myHub — no API keys.

connection.instructions: Click Connect and sign in to your Lightspeed Retail (X-Series) account. myHub handles the OAuth handshake and token refresh automatically — no API keys or manual token copying needed. You'll be asked to authorize access to your Lightspeed store during sign-in.
